title: Sultan e Deen Shahe Khurasaa Guzargaya
body:
Sultan e deen shahe khurasaa guzargaya
Mamoon na rashhed ka mehmaa guzargaya
1. Angoor zaherdaar ne mara imam ko
Kazim ka laal bolta quraan guzargaya
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bewaa yateem bacchoun ke wali ne ki qaza
Be warisoo ka haayr nighebaan guzargaya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Moula taqi yateem hovey margaye Raza
Kounain ke sukun ka saama guzargaya
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Gurbat mein shaan se uthi mayyat garib ki
Be kas pukara dard ka darmaan guzargaya
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Gham ke pahad toode hai ummat ne mustafa
Ek aur aaj maasire yazdaa guzargaya
